summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Orion Digital Corp. (formerly Mogo Inc.), a Canadian foreign private issuer, containing its Notice of Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and Management Information Circular for a meeting scheduled June 23, 2026. The filing covers standard annual meeting items: receiving audited financial statements, electing directors, appointing auditor MNP LLP, and transacting other business. The board recommends voting FOR all resolutions. No special situation event is disclosed; this is a routine proxy circular and meeting notice. There are no deal terms or transactional elements present.
